description: For the ShearQuery team: change a queued comment's wording, move it to another day (date YYYY-MM-DD, or "next" for the next good day), mark it posted (after someone posted it on Instagram) or skipped (with a reason), or put it back to pending. A day must have room (5) and keep the account 7 days from its other comments.
name: update_ig_comment
title: Edit, skip or mark a queued comment posted
